criteria.summary: 30-day active TTL and post-tombstone horizon are explicit; immutable owner/ref/approval/validity metadata is revalidated per batch with PostgreSQL time; UNCERTAIN never auto-expires.
resource_id is removed only from mature tombstones while tenant/key/digest/timestamps remain; the migration constraint prevents invalid active/minimized shapes.
Offline and disposable PostgreSQL measurements use the approved 30-day horizon, explicit synthetic origin, p50/p95 row size, index size, total size and sweep timing for three volumes.
Direct retention was selected; no archive/partition exists. Durable primary-key consultation remains authoritative and database failure has no permissive fallback.
Reader and writer statements prepared before migration remain executable after it, including a NULL resource_id read; replay remains rejected by the unchanged tenant/key primary key.
Synthetic long-horizon rows process in bounded batches and restart to convergence; hold changes serialize on the same advisory lock and the update rechecks holds; preserved rows are counted.
The v3 critic findings were remediated; final full regression/static/docs checks passed, the v4 re-review passed C01-C06, and the candidate is sealed by the v2 binding verifier.

limitations: Controlled local evidence only; no staging or production authorization.
No destructive purge, archive or partitioning is implemented.
The independent reviewer could not reproduce PostgreSQL in its shell because TEST_DATABASE_URL was unset; the main run executed the conditional file 13/13 against disposable local PostgreSQL.
